_help: Ads on the events list. 'enabled' switches all ads on or off; each ad has its own 'enabled'. Members (and staff) see a service, everyone else the membership ad. 'by_group' picks the service when the list is filtered to one Innovation Group (monday IG number); 'general' is shown otherwise, one at random. 'slot' is the position in the upcoming list. Text comes from the SFR Service Catalogue 2027.

membership.label: Swiss Food Research membership
membership.headline: Your organisation in 12 Innovation Groups, with 280+ member organisations
membership.body: Members join every Innovation Group meeting at no extra cost, open the presentations, and get coaching, funding support and Radicle – Knowledge. Non-members attend twice for free.

coaching.label: 1:1 Coaching
coaching.headline: A neutral expert who sharpens your innovation question
coaching.body: You leave with clear next steps, contacts and funding options.

funding.label: Funding Support
funding.headline: Over 100 funding instruments in Switzerland. We help you find the right one and win it
funding.body: Bring your project idea to a coaching session. We match it to the scheme and review your proposal before you submit.

novel_food.label: Novel-Food Check
novel_food.headline: Find out early whether your food needs novel-food authorisation
novel_food.body: Bring a short product description. We check it against the EU and Swiss rules and document the result.

maas.label: MaaS
maas.headline: A go, change or stop decision on your product, before the first production run
maas.body: From a short brief, we simulate about 300 customer interviews across three market scenarios.

farmer.label: Farmer Support
farmer.headline: Free, confidential support for farmers turning an idea into a funded project
farmer.body: A first meeting on your farm clarifies the problem, the partners you need and the funding options.

equipment.label: Equipment Sharing
equipment.headline: Lend idle equipment, or find the machine you need, within the network
equipment.body: Tell us what you offer or need. We propose matches; you agree the terms directly.

innoloop.label: Innoloop
innoloop.headline: Professional chefs help you develop a product or improve a recipe
innoloop.body: Chefs test your product and give honest feedback on taste, handling and use, before launch.

route2market.label: Route2Market
route2market.headline: Put your product in front of real buyers, shelves and kitchens before you spend heavily on launch
route2market.body: Free for members: test your riskiest assumptions about customers, price and sales channels.

ecosystem.label: Ecosystem Map and Matchmaking
ecosystem.headline: A map of the partners your idea needs, and warm introductions to them
ecosystem.body: We break your idea into the roles it needs, find candidates for each and introduce you.
